title: _process
description: A named definition of a process: the steps of the flow, who does each one and what each one waits for. It knows nothing about the entities that run it. Approval is not part of it. Draft v0.

id.description: Stable name, entered by whoever defines the process; it is the kind of work, such as "code" or "article", referenced by _work (`type`). Lowercase letters, digits, "-" and "_" only: no other special characters, no ".".

steps.description: May be omitted on input; normalization sets it to [].

name.description: Name of the step, such as WORK or REVIEW. Unique in the process.

role.description: The role that does the step.

dependOn.description: Names of the steps of this process that must be finished before this one starts. Steps that do not depend on each other run in parallel.

instructions.description: Default instructions of the step, as a template. Whoever uses the process can override them.
